consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly agree that the June 10, 1990 show at Cal Expo is one of the best performances of the year, showcasing high energy and exceptional musicianship. Standout moments include powerful renditions of 'Bertha,' 'Jack Straw,' and 'Eyes of the World,' with Phil's bass playing receiving particular praise.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 63 reviews + 1.5 sentiment: The high praise for the performance quality and standout songs, along with the positive energy of the crowd, significantly enhances the overall sentiment.
